verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a state online business-filing portal could publish operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts before a filer starts. Nothing in the pack mentions any such window, limit, or timeout. The Gateway and tax items cover login tips, OHID security and tax tools, and the SOS filing portal itself was not readable beyond a robots.txt 403.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
